name: Dependent Endorsement on Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses and children under 18 of a Class A, B, or C residence permit holder may be endorsed onto that permit. A separate re-entry pass costs USD 50 per person.
requirements.fix_path: Apply to have the spouse/child endorsed onto the principal permit holder's residence permit.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or child's birth certificate

outcome.duration_length: tied to the principal permit holder's permit validity

sources.title: Embassy of Tanzania, Washington D.C. -- confirms dependents (spouses and children under 18) may be endorsed on Class A/B/C residence permits; re-entry pass USD 50 per person

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Tanzania). STATUS: DRAFT -- the tier-1 source confirms the endorsement mechanism exists but gives no procedural detail specific to it (its own application steps, fees beyond the re-entry pass, or age-18+ children's options), so this is modeled thinly and marked draft pending a dedicated dependent-permit source. family_can_join set false at this route's own level since this route describes the dependent being brought in, not the dependent themself sponsoring further family; work_rights set 'none' as no independent work right for endorsed dependents was found; study_rights set 'restricted' rather than 'full' since access for endorsed dependents specifically (as opposed to Class C students in their own right) was not detailed.
